falsifiers.description: Question-observed or school-observed skill promoted to universal grade-level curriculum truth without explicit authority binding.
Direct rendering from raw questions without going through the intermediate PrimaryMathSkillModel.
Area model partition label does not equal the product of its sub-dimensions (e.g. 20 x 6 labeled as 12 instead of 120).
Partial product step omitted from multi-digit multiplication bridge (e.g. 23 x 6 omitting 18).
Final product does not equal the sum of declared partial products.
Vertical algorithm presented without explicit place-value decomposition bridge.
Sharing (partitive) and grouping (quotitive) meanings collapsed into an identical generic visual/quantity structure.
Internal quotient zero omitted when partial dividend < divisor after division has begun (e.g. 366/12=36 or 7843/13=63).
Division check relation violated: divisor * quotient + remainder != dividend.
Division remainder is negative or greater than or equal to divisor.
Remainder interpretation in word problem does not match required contextual action (e.g. round up buses, report leftovers).
Unit chain conversion skipped (e.g. 23 dozen eggs multiplied directly by unit rate instead of converting to individual eggs first).
Unequal physical/coordinate partitions presented as equal unit fractions.
Number of shaded parts does not match the numerator of the declared fraction.
Fraction inequality asserted without common denominator, common numerator, benchmark, or visual model reasoning.
Fraction addition incorrectly sums denominators (e.g. 1/4 + 2/4 = 3/8).
Expanded form digit values do not match standard base-10 positional values.
Count of shaded squares on 10x10 grid does not reconcile with declared decimal hundredths value.
Plotted position on decimal number line does not match numerical decimal value.
Conversion multiplier between units contradicts standard SI/customary definition.
Boundary measure (linear units) conflated with surface covering (square units).
Unit cube / layer count does not equal product of declared 3D dimensions.
Rendered visual angle geometry contradicts declared angle classification or degree measure.
Bar height, dot plot count, or pictogram symbols do not reconcile with chart scale key.
Problem analysis fails to define explicit quantity, unit, role, relationship, and unknown before computation.
Learner error is silently rewritten into correct work rather than preserved as an explicit contrast object.
Structured replay or authored example mislabeled as original source handwriting.
Digits across rows in vertical arithmetic do not align along vertical place-value columns.
Teacher annotations or marks are recorded as child-produced evidence.
Illegible or ambiguous student writing resolved into definitive answer without ambiguity marker.
Correct intermediate substeps omitted or judged incorrect because final answer was wrong.
Core 1 module provides only text summary and exercises without an instructional representation bridge.
Core 1 fails to support the required learning progression (Notice -> Model -> Worked -> Supported -> Independent).
Appendix A practice batch lacks an explicit pedagogical practice role (RECONNECT, BUILD, CHOOSE, etc.).
Appendix B hint ladder omits standard levels (H1 Notice, H2 Remember, H3 Represent) or lacks fresh H0 independent retry.
Appendix C visual quick reference replaced with dense prose text summary.
Core 2 references Core 1 via fragile authored physical page numbers instead of stable semantic IDs.
Internal architectural, diagnostic, prompt, or engine tokens leaked onto student-facing pages.
Learner body text rendered below child readability minimum (12pt) or shrunk to fit instead of pagination.
Primitive draw call ignored input parameters and rendered hardcoded example constants (PR #310 defect).
